name: Raven Hill
summary: In western Duskwood, shadows move through Raven Hill, and a light flickers in a ruined window. Elaine Carevin sends travelers from Darkshire to learn what has taken shelter there.

sections.title: Eyes in the West
sections.body: The Night Watch has long left Duskwood’s far west to the dead and wilderness. Yet signs of life there demand attention. Calor, a watcher on the gloomy roads, saw movement among Raven Hill’s silent houses two nights in a row. A lantern flickered in a window. With ghouls, skeletons, and beasts across the land, the Night Watch cannot ignore what stirs among the ruins.

sections.title: A Rattled Hermit
sections.body: Inside Raven Hill, Jitters trembles at every sound in the dark. The vagabond huddles among the ruined buildings and insists there is no danger beyond harmless Jitters. His frantic rambling hints that he knows more about the nightmare consuming Duskwood than he dares to say.

faq.q: Who sends you to investigate Raven Hill?
faq.answer: Elaine Carevin, who lives in Darkshire and assists the Night Watch, asks travelers concerned for Duskwood’s safety to investigate disturbing reports from the west.

faq.q: What did Calor actually see in Raven Hill?
faq.answer: Calor saw shadows moving through Raven Hill’s abandoned settlement two nights in a row. The night before, he saw a lantern or candle burning in a building window.

faq.q: What monster is haunting the ruins?
faq.answer: You are sent to discover what haunts Raven Hill. Calor saw moving shadows and a light in a window, but only a visit to the ruined buildings can reveal what lurks there.
Jitters is a paranoid vagrant living in western Duskwood, always close to terror. He claims to be harmless, but his guilt and frantic rambling hint at a connection to the region’s darker mysteries.
Raven Hill lies in far western Duskwood, just south of the great undead-infested cemetery that shares its name.

faq.q: Why is the Night Watch so concerned about moving shadows?
faq.answer: Darkshire’s defenders are stretched thin by skeletal uprisings, feral worgen, and lurking spiders. Strange inhabitants or organized movement in the abandoned west could threaten the remaining living settlements.

angles.text: The Night Watch receives little or no aid from Stormwind’s garrison. As an Alliance hero, you may be called on to investigate threats in Duskwood’s ruined corners.
As a paladin, you are trained to hunt the restless undead in the neighboring cemetery. The trembling, flesh-and-blood Jitters may be an unexpected discovery.
